title: Tools to Download and Explore Datasets from the French Open Data Platform
text: datagouv provides small client public API data.gouv.fr, French government’s open data platform. lets list datasets published platform, download tabular resources compute summary metrics (file weight, number columns, missing-value rates, …). Requests built top httr2 package. approach mirrors several US cities propose (e.g. nycOpenData New York), tailored data.gouv.fr API.

datagouv 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development version. dg_list_datasets() lists datasets available data.gouv.fr returns tibble title, id, description slug. format_tibble() converts data frame tibble can drop rows containing missing values. get_summary() computes key metrics (weight, number variables, number rows, missing-value proportion) dataset. summarise_datasets() computes summary metrics collection datasets, disambiguating duplicate titles output appending dataset’s id. dg_pull_dataset() downloads dataset stable, unique id (, fallback, exact title) parses . read_resource() auto-detects delimiter CSV/TXT resources (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, …) dispatches matching readr reader (read_csv(), read_csv2() European files, read_tsv(), read_delim()), adds support JSON resources (array newline-delimited) via jsonlite. wrapper_datasets() downloads several datasets id returns raw tables summary metrics.
